The first useful decision was a refusal. A tempting shortcut would have hidden the source of the work, so the shortcut stayed on the shelf.

## A smaller system

The replacement was plain: one **structured prompt**, one visible proof, and one review before anything moved forward.

- Keep the source visible.
- Test the claim.
- Publish only after review.

The [field notes index](/field-notes/) keeps the rest of the record.
